name: Python asyncio
description: Concurrent Python with asyncio, from the event loop up.

chapters.title: Async HTTP Clients & Servers
chapters.topic: Async HTTP in Python: aiohttp ClientSession and httpx.AsyncClient lifecycle, connection pooling and limits, per-request and total timeouts, bounded concurrency for many requests, retries with backoff, streaming responses, async web servers (aiohttp.web, FastAPI/Starlette async def vs def endpoints), running blocking code from handlers, graceful shutdown.
